In the early 2000s, this was one of the first kpop songs that went viral in the Philippines and we didn't even know it was Korean. Thought it was a Mexican or Spanish song😂 Then came Nobody by Wonder Girls, Fire by 2ne1, Gangnam Style by Psy, Fantastic Baby by BigBang

So yeah, the pioneers really paved the way 😌
